hooks.name: Spec Drift
hooks.description: Verify the just-completed task's acceptance criteria still hold against the actual diff. If code and spec diverged, open a refresh note.

action.prompt: Verify the just-completed task's acceptance criteria still hold against the actual diff. If code and spec diverged, open a refresh note in the spec folder and mark the task for review. If the change touches services/ai-invoker/**, prompts/**, or KB ingestion configs: also require the clause-accuracy and grounding-adversarial suites to run against staging before the task may close.
